approvers: Developer or main contractor who sets the subcontract package
reason: Film and tape cost me pennies a square metre and nobody in the subcontract package asks me for anything more. I'm not paying about €19/m² for something the main contractor hasn't specified and won't pay for.
objection: Almost €19/m² for a peel-off coating when film and tape cost well under €1/m² in material. It's a new budget line and a new supplier for no extra income on the job.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, bought locally, and pass any damage risk back through the subcontract terms.
would_change_my_mind: If the developer or main contractor wrote it into the specification and paid for it as a separate line, I'd look at it.
